_readme: One entry per offer. The picker scores every deck against `keywords` (title hits count x3), keeps only offers whose `disciplines` include the deck's discipline (or 'any'), and falls back to `fallback` when nothing scores >= min_score. Keep keywords lowercase; Arabic keywords are matched without diacritics. See offers/README.md.
